description: Entity annotations for specific PubMed articles: every gene, disease, chemical, variant, species and cell-line mention in the title and abstract (or PMC full text), each normalized to NCBI Gene / MeSH / dbSNP / Taxonomy ids with its character offsets, plus any relations PubTator 3 extracted within the article. Up to 20 PMIDs per call. Sourced from the PubTator 3 BioC JSON export at NCBI/NLM; all annotations are machine-extracted. Keyless.

full_text.description: Return PMC open-access full-text passages when available (default false: title + abstract only). Full text can be 100+ passages; each passage is truncated to 1,500 characters.

name: pubtator_annotations
title: Pubtator Annotations
